code:
mkdir -p .agents/skills
curl -fsSL -o smo.skill https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BillJr99/Ursinus-CS357-Fall2026/gh-pages/files/small-model-orchestrator.skill
unzip -q smo.skill -d .agents/skills/ && rm smo.skill
ls .agents/skills/small-model-orchestrator/SKILL.md
description: Creates .agents/skills directory, downloads the skill archive, extracts it, and verifies SKILL.md exists.

steps.description: Download: curl fetches the skill archive from GitHub Pages.
Extraction: unzip into .agents/skills/ and remove the archive.
Verification: ls confirms SKILL.md is at the expected path.
